name: Spring Point Tavern
description: The Portland area venue offers a lively karaoke experience with a welcoming atmosphere. Known for its friendly staff and vibrant crowd, it features live entertainment multiple nights a week, including karaoke, DJ dance parties, and open mic nights. The venue boasts a solid sound system, a diverse song library, and a cozy, neighborhood vibe that makes it a favorite spot for locals and visitors alike. Food and drinks are available until late, enhancing the fun-filled nights.
